review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–96) without opening any related sources. It has three theorems. The surjectivity proof is a short germ argument that appears once. The two `toSheafify` isomorphism instances are routine applications of one existing API lemma, so they are not substantial repeated proof machinery.
